d: Bihar ke begusray men kendriy mantri aur sthaniy sansad giriraj sinh ke khilaph sthaniy yuvaon aur karyakartaon ne anokha virodh-pradarshan kiya hai. vikas karyon ki andekhi ka aarop lagate hue pradarshankariyon ne anokhe andaj men narebaji ki, jiska eksaklusiv vidiyo intarnet par teji se trend kar raha hai. dekhie begusray se yah graund riporta.
